delivery.outcome: koru scan's pytest --collect-only probe passes -p no:wellmanifest_governance so the managed governance bridge no longer spawns the ~25s gate subprocess during read-only inventory collection, fixing the recurring pytest_collect_timeout tickets (STARTER-675); probe timeout_seconds raised 30->60 to cover cold collection of the ~4400-test suite (~40s uncached)
nonGoals: no changes to the managed wellmanifest_governance.py bridge (pinned by adoption lock; upstream fix is a separate standard adoption)
no changes to real test sessions, which keep full gate enforcement

architecture.decision: append -p no:wellmanifest_governance to the collect-only probe argv; pytest treats it as a no-op for projects without the plugin; default timeout_seconds raised to 60 for cold-cache collection

validation.evidence: collection finishes well inside the 30s probe budget
